name: pricing_engine_iterrows
description: Performance regression from replacing vectorized pandas operations with iterrows() row-by-row calculation

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing 50k iterrows() calls as bottleneck

variants.name: misleading
variants.description: Suggests DataFrame.apply() as the fix for iterrows() (real fix: vectorized column operations)

success_criteria.description: Final price values unchanged from baseline

ground_truth.root_cause: df.iterrows() creates a full pandas Series object for every row — 50k Series allocations dominate the runtime
ground_truth.misleading_fix: Replace iterrows() with df.apply(lambda r: ..., axis=1) → ~0.38s, 70% improvement, still FAILS threshold 0.20s
